method.integrity_gate: Reconciled every record to the aggregate source manifest by asset ID, source asset ID, path, SHA-256, scene, and mechanism.
method.visual_gate: Independently inspected every labeled B1-B6 panel and reconciled the visible composition against its specific_physical_scene, single_mechanism, and strict BRAND-1.6 rejection classes.
method.acceptance_rule: Generation, decode, dimensions, hash integrity, and machine metrics do not imply editorial acceptance; any strict visual exclusion or failure to practically depict the requested mechanism is a reject.
